claim: A finite distinguishability-loss surrogate may authorize one transition only when facts are generated independently of proposals, every admissible equivalence is enumerated, the complete MSS Pareto front is unique, held-out and mutation gates pass, and an append-only pawl is valid.

math.input: I=(X,T,E0,D,w), with T reflexive and symmetric, E0 an equivalence, and T subseteq E0
math.candidate: E is an equivalence satisfying T subseteq E subseteq E0
math.loss: L_D(E)=sum_{i<j} w_ij * 1[(i,j) in D and E(i,j)]
math.admissible: g>0 and T subseteq E subseteq E0 and E is an equivalence
math.commit_rule: COMMIT only when the complete nondominated admissible set contains exactly one relation
math.plural_rule: A plural nondominated set returns HOLD_MSS_AMBIGUOUS

code_gates: P0 freeze spec, fact generator, oracle, mutation list, validator, and absent builder paths
P1 facts contain no expected decision, target rung, preferred proposal, or proposal-derived demand
P2 enumerate every equivalence between T and E0 and independently check completeness
P3 Julia, JAX, and PyTorch lanes receive only the frozen instance and write into isolated empty result roots
P4 every control traverses the same loss and decision implementation; literal control outcomes are forbidden
P5 return the complete MSS Pareto front; hidden scalarization and index tie-breaks are forbidden
P6 simultaneously permute T, E0, D, and w and require decision invariance plus relation equivariance
P7 demand perturbations are recomputed and the held-out estate contains genuine flips and no-flips
P8 after engine source freeze generate at least 256 held-out n=4..8 cases with zero oracle mismatches
P9 z3 and cvc5 bind measured instance facts and reject erased transitivity or erased demand facts
P10 coherent source-level semantic mutations regenerate receipts and must be rejected
P11 append-only pawl binds before, facts, candidate evidence, and after hashes; red is byte-identical and replay idempotent
P12 all promotion, launch, QIT, entropy, Axis, and terrain/operator consumers remain blocked
accepted_green_ceiling: one finite distinguishability-loss surrogate transition generalized on post-seal held-out cases
blocked_consumers: LLM or provider verdict as a gate
